text:
ana: FYI found leftover KMS-wrapped vault blobs in partner project after last night's RBAC sweep. looks like grant deletions removed unwrap perms but wraps continued. need quick containment + rotation plan. cc @jamal @sophie

jamal: can you paste a sample audit line and the wrap key id?

ana: sample (sanitized):
```
2026-03-19T02:11:02Z vault.audit: event=wrap key_id=wrap-partner-9 user=svc-deployer
2026-03-19T02:11:04Z vault.audit: event=unwrap key_id=wrap-partner-9 err="KMS grant missing"
```
I also saw IAM change at ~02:05 UTC that removed kms.grants.bind for the partner SA.

sophie: rough estimate how many objects reference wrap-partner-9?

ana: GCS query: 87 objects in prefix partner/backups/2026-03-19, and older snapshots may reference it.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260319-3 opened (severity: high) 1: orphaned-wrapkey + missing KMS grants. Pager: @sec-oncall

mike: proposed immediate steps (short):
- block new wraps using the key (Vault deny policy on sys/wrapping/wrap)
- create emergency KMS grant scoped to svc-deployer for Unwrap only (least-priv)
- schedule rewrap job to new key with correct grants
- enable KMS audit forwarder for correlation

jamal: agree. add: rewrap should be batched, idempotent, and write metadata tag after success (wrap_key=new). also add a small safety window to process older-than X-days later.

sophie: terraform/gitops guard: add validation to iam repo to prevent direct deletion of kms.grants without a two-approver tag. I'll start a PR.

ana: paste a minimal rewrap flow?

jamal: pseudo: 
```
objects = list_gcs(prefix="partner/backups/")
for o in objects:
  meta = get_meta(o)
  if meta.wrap_key == "wrap-partner-9":
    if already_rewrapped(meta): continue
    c = download(o)
    p = kms_unwrap(c, key="wrap-partner-9")  # requires temp grant
    new_c = kms_wrap(p, key="wrap-partner-12")
    upload(o, new_c)
    set_meta(o, wrap_key="wrap-partner-12", rewrap_ts=now(), rewrap_actor="rewraper-1")
```
run with concurrency=3, checkpoint to pubsub per-batch. retry semantics: backoff and skip if meta indicates done.

mike: put a dry-run mode that logs which objects would change and a smoke test to ensure unwrap/rewrap correctness on a sample set. also, first-pass only touch last-30d artifacts.

ana: can infra stand up a runner for jamal?

mike: yes, will spin up a short-lived runner in partner project and create a temp SA with kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt only on new key. ETA 50m.

jamal: i'll own the job and orchestration. need temp grant on old key to unwrap while we rewrap. request: grant expire after we finish.

sophie: for auditability: add X-Vault-Trace header on wrap/unwrap calls and forward KMS admin logs to ELK with trace_id mapping. that way we can correlate vault+kms events for the postmortem.

ana: runbook checklist i'll post in INC ticket. quick checklist here:
- [ ] Vault deny policy to block new wraps applied
- [ ] emergency KMS grant created (Unwrap only)
- [ ] infra runner and temp SA ready
- [ ] rewrap job deployed (dry-run -> smoke -> full)
- [ ] KMS admin logs forwarding enabled
- [ ] terraform guard PR opened for iam repo

sec-oncall: acknowledged. i'll watch unwrap error rate and KMS audit stream. if error spike > 5% over baseline we'll pause and investigate.

mike: i'll update INC-20260319-3 as we progress and attach the rewrap job logs and dry-run report. tagging @eng-ml in case any models reference those blobs.

ana: thanks team. after containment we'll schedule a short postmortem and add a permanent guard in CI.
